translations.albanian: Allahu të shpërbleftë me të mira.
translations.english: (If someone does you a favour and you say: (May Allah reward you with goodness.) then you have indeed excelled in praising him.)
translations.indonesian: Semoga Allah memberi berkah kepadamu dan atasmu serta mengumpulkan kamu berdua (pengantin laki-laki dan perempuan) dalam kebaikan.
